name: CubeBackup-GoogleWorkspace
description: Self-hosted backup for Google Workspace. Protect Gmail, Google Drive, Shared drives, Contacts, and Calendar data with Cube Backup. NOTE: You must set permissions on the appdata folders and create your own config.toml file in the cfg directory as well.

paths.name: Index
paths.description: Location of the data index. The access speed of the data index is crucially important for the performance of the backup. Should be on cache or SSD pool.

paths.name: Backup Location
paths.description: Location of the backup data, likely will be on a share on your array.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Directory is the location to store the main configuration file (config.toml) for the CubeBackup app.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Directory is the location to store the other application settings, key files, and an SQLite database for sessions.

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: Directory stores log files for CubeBackup.
